doc.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11

title: Parade bass drummers, bands' drummers and Angelo Scirro
summary: Names of drummers and other players from bands of the day: Lambert, Williams, Laine and his son, Angelo Scirro.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Now, what about in the streets? Would you have a good bass drum?
Oh, in the parades?
Yeah.
Oh, Jack Lane used to play bass drum in the parades, and other fellas. Tots? They had good, they had good.
What about Emil Gonzalez? Was he very good on the bass drum?
Never even heard of him.
Never heard of Emil Gonzalez?
No.
Johnny Lala was telling me about him.

Well, I mean, there's a lot of those names you see from those fellas. I mean, they get away from you, you know. Sometimes they're nicknames, too. Yeah, and a lot of times they get away from you from being so far back, you can't remember.
And Brown's, and the bands of those days that were known bands, Brown had what? What's his name? Billy Lambert on drums and the other fella?
Yeah, Billy Lambert on drums, George guitar.
No, but drummers, we're talking about drummers. Was Billy Lambert and who else?
There's Billy Lambert and then there's Freddie Williams.
Freddie Williams. Now, no, that was, he was in Fish's band, Freddie Williams.
No, no, no.
Brown's band? Yeah, he played with us. Those fellas all, you know. He went to Chicago. His brother Frank Christian had Tots.
Mm-hmm.
And Brunus had who? Well, the Brunus never had a band of their own pack they got at that time, did they?
No. No. Because, let's see. Henry used to play with, he used to play with Jack a lot, Jack Lane.
Well, Jack Lane, when he played a pair, he had to play his own drum. He was a drummer. You see, he was a drummer. His son was a drummer. Hansi. Both of them were drummers.
What about Angelo Sciro?
Angelo Sciro. Angelo Sciro. Angelo Sciro. Angelo Sciro. And clarinet. He used to play clarinet a lot. Angelo Sciro.

I wonder if he's related to Lukey Sciro. I forgot to ask Lukey. You know Lukey? Lukey plays in Buck Banville for years. Lefty Arm and they were all in a band. You don't know Lukey? He's younger. When you started on drums, is that your first instrument, was it, I understand?
